title: clear totem
description: Makes the Totem of Undying semi-transparent for a cleaner view while keeping the vanilla look.
body:
# Clear Totem
This resource pack replaces the default Totem of Undying texture with a semi-transparent version at 30% opacity.

**Perfect for players who find the vanilla totem distracting while fighting, building, speedrunning, or exploring.**

### Features:

* 30% opacity totem texture
* Better screen visibility
* No FPS loss
* Lightweight resource pack
* Supports Minecraft Java Edition 1.20–1.26.x
* No pack compatibility warnings

### Why Use It?
Vanilla totems take up massive screen space. This pack keeps the item perfectly recognizable while giving you the tactical edge you need during intense PvP and survival combat.

### Modpack Usage:
You are free to include this resource pack in any modpack, whether hosted on Modrinth, CurseForge, or other platforms. No explicit permission is required, though credit is always appreciated!

**made by Duro_85** 😎
